body.heading: The situation
paragraphs: Bayou Trace Coffee Roasters had built a loyal following over five years, but nothing about how the brand looked matched the quality of what was in the bag.

case_studies.summary: Bayou Trace had loyal customers but no visual identity holding it together. We rebuilt their brand around one idea, small-batch and local, so every touchpoint reinforces it.
case_studies.quoteText: Our coffee never changed. The way people saw us did.
case_studies.chapter: A five-year-old roasting operation with no consistent look across its bags, website, or market booth.
case_studies.afterNote: New customers now recognize Bayou Trace before they taste it.
case_studies.beforeNote: Customers recognized the coffee by taste, not by look.
case_studies.title: From backroom roaster to a name people drive for
case_studies.after: Unified packaging, brand guidelines, refreshed website and market signage
